method.tensor_inspection: Safetensors JSON headers only; no tensor values loaded.

verification_scope: Integrity of selected local MLX installation against local content-addressed manifests; not upstream authenticity or numerical correctness.

identity.note: Distribution digest is not a Google/Hugging Face source revision. No source revision is established by local metadata.

logical_parameter_counts.note: For nvfp4 U32 storage, logical last dimension = stored dimension * 8; scaling tensors are excluded from logical parameter count. Show total includes draft and omits four bias tensors.

main.configured_model_max_length_note: Tokenizer sentinel; use text_config.max_position_embeddings for architectural context limit.

draft/.configured_model_max_length_note: Tokenizer sentinel; use text_config.max_position_embeddings for architectural context limit.

chat_template.note: The visible template is a passthrough. Effective chat serialization uses built-in gemma4 renderer; its implementation was not captured or evaluated in this read-only file audit. No chat_template field is present in packaged tokenizer configs.

eos_pad.note: Generation stop IDs differ from text config EOS; retain each source separately.

manifest_files.verification_note: Locally generated compatibility manifest has no independently supplied expected digest; fingerprint only.
Compared with embedded original manifest-list digest.

known_limitations: Hashes establish consistency with local manifests, not authenticity relative to an independently retrieved upstream release.
